predictor_provenance.note: Runtime hit totals include estimated rows; separate using gx_estimate_provenance. Same durations as archived partial comparison. No new GPU profiling.

limitations: Estimated durations are the identical archived 45 shape-scaling estimates, inserted before execution; no offline modification of observed epoch timestamps.
Predictor runtime calls estimated rows hits; this audit reclassifies them using the SQLite provenance table.
No native eight-GPU validation. GPU profile originates from an A100-40GB; modeled capacity is 80GiB.
Full-sync spans include epoch/worker/wait costs; post-attachment application perf_counter uses virtual time. Physical host duration is in result.applications.
